objective: test whether sequence-conditioned ProteinMPNN structure likelihood, discovered with ESM-C 600M, improves the strongest existing ESM-C 6B GPCR mutation rank

decision.reason: The development-selected 6B structure blend failed both external checks. A post-hoc 3% structure prior preserved the official rank and slightly increased C5aR AP, but did not recover another positive in the top 50 and its paired bootstrap intervals included zero improvement.
decision.interpretation: The 600M experiment identified a real development-set structure association, but that association did not scale into a robust new-receptor improvement when attached to the 6B production rank.

sequence_rank.formula: 0.60 * within-scan ESM-C 600M MPTherm percentile + 0.15 * within-scan ESM-C 600M masked-marginal percentile + 0.25 * within-scan ESM-C 6B MPTherm percentile

structure_score.formula: mean over 16 random decoding orders of log P(mutant | backbone, remaining WT sequence) - log P(WT | backbone, remaining WT sequence)

development_policy.split: GPCR-tm official training rows, excluding three rows at official test mutation sites
development_policy.grouping: whole receptor; every score converted to a within-receptor percentile

logic_discovery.note: Only the structure-score mode was carried forward. The blend weight was reselected against the 6B rank.

scale_selection.note: The recomputed sequence baseline differs slightly from the recorded runtime value 0.11686278346026927 because this paired audit was reconstructed from stored float16 feature tensors. Candidate and baseline use the same reconstruction.

post_hoc_small_prior_diagnostic.reason_for_reporting: This is the best observed small-weight compromise that preserved the already-consulted official macro rank while improving the point estimates on C5aR. It was inspected after the selected 0.80 blend failed and is therefore not an untouched confirmation.

limitations: The official GPCR-tm confirmation contains only 12 rows and has been consulted repeatedly.
C5aR is one receptor and its binary thermostability labels are not calibrated delta-Tm or delta-delta-G.
The GPCR-tm structures and C5aR AlphaFold structure do not have identical provenance or uncertainty.
A ProteinMPNN likelihood is a sequence-backbone compatibility score, not a physical stability unit.
No untouched GPCR benchmark remains for promoting the post-hoc 3% diagnostic.
